IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Hunt, Alexander, Williams, and Kenney

Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting parking charges imposed by the state on employees from excise taxes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting parking charges imposed by the stateon employees from excise taxes; adding a new section to chapter 82.08RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.29A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to automobileparking charges charged by the state to employees of the state.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.29A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All leasehold interests in stateowned property used for automobileparking by employees of the state are exempt from tax under thischapter.
